query: WITH role_holder AS (SELECT DISTINCT workspace_user.user_id FROM role_binding INNER JOIN workspace_user ON workspace_user.actor_id = role_binding.actor_id WHERE role_binding.workspace_id = $1 AND role_binding.role_id = $2) SELECT role_holder.user_id AS "user_id!: Uuid", "user".first_name, "user".last_name, "user".email, COUNT(*) OVER() AS "total_count!" FROM role_holder INNER JOIN "user" ON role_holder.user_id = "user".id WHERE ($3::TEXT IS NULL OR "user".email ILIKE '%' || $3::TEXT || '%') AND ($4::TEXT IS NULL OR "user".first_name ILIKE '%' || $4::TEXT || '%') AND ($5::TEXT IS NULL OR "user".last_name ILIKE '%' || $5::TEXT || '%') ORDER BY role_holder.user_id LIMIT $6 OFFSET $7;
